name: Ascension Parish, LA
findings: Ascension Parish has 257 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ascension Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Ascension Parish list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Ascension Parish list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: No education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
